title: Uruguayan Dried White Corn Empanadas
description: Earthly and crunchy empanadas filled with dried white corn, perfect for a festive occasion, this flexitarian friendly dish is a delight to the senses.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour and salt.
Add the melted butter, beaten egg, and water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of soaked and drained dried white corn in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
